name: stackblitzrc

installDependencies.title: Install npm dependencies when opening the project.
installDependencies.description: Defaults to true. Set to false to disable.

startCommand.title: Execute a custom command when opening the project.
startCommand.description: If not provided, a command may be inferred based on the project files (e.g. running `npm start`).

env.title: Expose environment variables to the terminal.

description:
Please note that the project is configured to install its npm dependencies automatically when the workspace opens. The startup routine is set to run the standard `npm start` command, so the application will launch without any additional scripting.  

For the runtime environment we have defined three variables: the API key is **abcd1234efgh**, the server will listen on port **3000**, and debug mode is explicitly disabled (false).
